notes.title: Match Shot Chimera is out now!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="CP1B28B2-6I;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Match Shot Chimera's out now on Steam Early Access![/p][p]It's been a lot of work, and I plan for it to be a lot more work after this![/p][p][/p][p]Compared to the demo there are lots of new things:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651965/f384fcf92f1255554c7d09e5ba82f813b5254550.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]New character: Wally (shield bubble, makes shield walls)[/p][/*][*][p]New character: Perry (parries enemy shots on swap!)[/p][/*][*][p]New level: SPACE![/p][/*][*][p]New enemies: alien-shaped baddies. Lots of brain jars and strange new enemy attack styles.[/p][/*][*][p]Ichor upgrade shop: permanent progression between runs[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple difficulties: stronger enemies, faster enemies, longer levels.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I'm eager to hear what you think! How's it play? Favorite characters? Is blocking in a shmup a crime?[/p][p]I'm happy with the game so far, but it won't last you for ages at this point. Multiple characters and difficulty levels to play with is a start! Future releases will focus strongly on improving replayability and the overall content amount.[/p][p]What's next:[/p][list][*][p]More upgrades, for more varied runs![/p][/*][*][p]More control over your mid-run upgrade choices[/p][/*][*][p]More characters[/p][/*][*][p]More enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty-specific enemies and wave designs[/p][/*][*][p]More unique enemy behaviors and formations[/p][/*][*][p]More beautiful and evil bullet patterns to dodge[/p][/*][*][p]Better level backgrounds[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Match Shot Chimera is now coming out September 24th
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651965/03d1f6fc364e2bed775efaf0b1636097e4940009.png"][/img][/p][p]Match Shot Chimera has been delayed to September 24.[/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for the delay. Match Shot Chimera was ready for September 9th but there were some things out of my control in Steam's backend.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm happy to have more time to polish and promote before release, though! Match Shot Chimera will be coming at you better than ever September 24th![/p]

notes.title: Match Shot Chimera blends together a shoot 'em up with clever match-3 mechanics
notes.notes:
Match-3 and blow everything up in Match Shot Chimera, a unique fusion of two rather different genres of games into something fun.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/match-shot-chimera-blends-together-a-shoot-em-up-with-clever-match-3-mechanics/

notes.title: What's next: New characters and persistent upgrades!
notes.notes: [p]It's been great getting the latest version of the demo out to everyone for Steam Next Fest. I wanted to show you all what I've been working on for the full version of the game lately, starting with new characters and persistent upgrades![/p][p][/p][h2]New Characters[/h2][p][/p][p]The starting character, ever-heroic Jeremy, has a pretty simple charge skill: Focus Fire. For the second character I wanted to have a skill that pretty dramatically changes the play-style.[/p][p][/p][p]Meet Wally and his shield![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651965/90de468675af6df9ec90c297f76a93370bf9e1ec.gif"][/img][/p][p]It only adds to your break meter when taking a hit, but two hits will be enough to break a block entirely. On break you drop a temporary shield wall.[/p][p][/p][p]A shield's pretty powerful in a shmup, but this is also [b]much[/b] larger than your standard weak spot (the pupil). I think this is a fairly balanced place to start, but will certainly keep an eye on how this plays out.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651965/99d6f23c4d0e9127832086297b10e2ff00fb3c19.gif"][/img][/p][p]This is Perry![/p][p][/p][h2]Persistent Upgrades[/h2][p][/p][p]You'll be able to spend the ichor you accumulate across runs on persistent upgrades. They'll make you more powerful and give you more options on your next run.[/p][p][/p][p]The best way to show that off quickly is... a gif of UI. Delicious.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651965/93212a132d5dc1486e431feaa43040d88933f50e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Besides what's pictured I'm also planning on upgrades that affect the kinds of encounters that spawn, your ability to reroll your upgrades on level-up, and a good few other ideas. But these six are a good place to start for now![/p][p][/p][p]I'll be posting about the game's third level and new enemies/minibosses next. Thanks again for your feedback, wishlists and demo reviews! They're a huge help for this tiny team.[/p]

notes.title: New Demo Version! (alpha 0.6)
notes.notes: [p]As always, you can get the latest version of the Match Shot Chimera Demo right here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730320/Match_Shot_Chimera_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you haven't tried the demo yet: please do! It's the best way to try out this lil' match-3 shmup at the moment, and I'd love to hear what you think so far. It works great on Steam Deck![/p][p][/p][p]I've improved the effects for matching blocks and player damage quite a bit in this update, which should improve the game's feel and make getting damaged much more noticeable![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651965/0e2839f3451ce7212491131f17afbf295bb44a85.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I've used some of that same tech to improve the "colored vector" render style, as well![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651965/cbb93400620b2fd7e0a516740efdf689331dbc88.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There are a lot of other changes I've made recently which are focused on the upcoming early access release. I'll detail those in another post soon! But there are many fixes and improvements to the demo in this update, as well. I've included more comprehensive patch notes below.[/p][p][/p][p][b]alpha 0.6 Patch Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved effects for match explosions[/p][/*][*][p]Improved damaged player effects[/p][/*][*][p]Improved colored vector render style[/p][/*][*][p]Improved UI scaling, especially on Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemy bullets disappearing early[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unreliable break meter display[/p][/*][*][p]Title screen now only plays cutscene on first load[/p][/*][*][p]Settings UI arrow buttons now repeat while mouse down[/p][/*][*][p]Added controller binding for style swap[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI hang while generating keyboard binding graphics[/p][/*][*][p]New save data format[/p][/*][*][p]Ichor is now awarded at the end of a run (not spendable in demo!)[/p][/*][/list]
